item.title: Dynamic Charging and Discharging Scheduling of Electric Vehicles Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
item.description:
Jingru Yang, Yue Ma, Ziwen Yang, Liping Zhou, and Na Geng.

Industrial Engineering Journal, 29(5), 48–58 (2026). Published in Chinese. .

We developed an event-triggered policy based on proximal policy optimization for a charging station with stochastic vehicle arrivals and departures. The numerical experiments compare aggregator revenue against benchmark scheduling algorithms.
